senses.definition_en: Awkward in movement or in handling things.
senses.definition_ar: أخرق أو ثقيل الحركة ويتعامل مع الأشياء بقلة براعة.
examples: The waiter was clumsy and spilled the wine.
The bulky equipment made the divers feel clumsy underwater.

senses.definition_en: Done or said without skill, tact, or grace.
senses.definition_ar: غير متقن أو يفتقر إلى اللباقة والبراعة.
examples: He made a clumsy attempt to catch the ball.
The waiter was clumsy and spilled the wine.
He made a clumsy attempt to catch the ball.
The bulky equipment made the divers feel clumsy underwater.
candidate.mnemonic: اربط الكلمة بعبارة 'كل ما يمسك' (Clum-sy) حاجة يوقعها ويكسرها لأنه شخص أخرق.
